method: SG17 TP8 RoCEnante small SUM reductions versus SG11 with identical target/draft FlashInfer MoE and original model precision. All five C1 coding trials, three C4/C8 coding trials and three prose trials are retained per run. The first SG17 run follows capability checks and a 128-request arithmetic burst; the repeat follows three long-context retrieval cases and further capability checks on the same process. The latest SG11 controls have initial and same-process post-long-context runs. Both SG11 controls precede SG17 chronologically. Coding text was not retained, and changes in reduction rounding can change generated output; prose previews are compared explicitly.
